music.prompt: Tight energetic percussion build at 128 BPM: punchy kick, crisp claps, fast ticking hi-hats and a snare roll that builds steadily and peaks right at the very end, like the seconds before a drop. Percussion only: no melody, no bass notes, no chords, no vocals.

High-energy upbeat indie-electronic groove at 128 BPM that starts immediately at full energy on the very first beat, no intro and no fade-in: punchy four-on-the-floor kick, big claps, a driving bass line, bright synth plucks and a catchy marimba hook. Euphoric, confident and fun, like a modern tech product launch. Full energy all the way through with no breakdown, ending on a big bright sustained final chord. No vocals, no singing.
